_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your SQL Server details. config.json is gitignored so credentials never get committed.
_filter_comment: Optional. The Excel->SQL loader only inserts rows whose Fiscal_Week (YYYYWW) is within this range. Set to keep e.g. 2025-2027 only; remove both keys to load all years. CLI --min-week/--max-week override these.

llm._comment: LLM Investigation Engine. Leave api_key blank on both slots to get the deterministic feature-based finding (never a fabricated conclusion). primary is tried first (NVIDIA); secondary is the Groq fallback. model is optional — DEFAULT_MODELS is used if blank. The console's per-queue model picker (selectable_models) can override the model per investigation; a specific picked model that fails is NOT silently answered by a different model — the deterministic finding is returned instead.
llm._selectable_models_comment: Optional. Models the console's per-queue picker offers (filtered to providers with a key). Verify ids against your account — the NVIDIA catalog lists models not provisioned for every account. Omit to use the built-in default list.
